review.reviewer: Codex implementation owner (self-review, not independent approval)
review.decision: Test a late same-model legacy write after the new observer explicitly clears effort
review.notes: Use a disposable HOME and generation-one fixtures. Apply the actual hook parser and the old same-model update semantics to the legacy JSON under its original lease, without invoking an installed hook or real tmux. Compare the original candidate and the fixed candidate; model-only refresh must not count as a new effort observation.

cases.description: A model-only refresh from a legacy profile writer cannot resurrect effort cleared by the new writer
cases.setup: A private HOME with an old profile containing a model and effort, or an effort-only profile without a model.
cases.action: Read the old record, clear effort via the new observer, then update just the same model via the old writer semantics. Read a second time and verify that a separately observed later effort can still be used. In the effort-only case read after clearing the final fact.
cases.expected: Legacy facts remain readable before the new observer runs. Clearing persists even when it leaves no facts. Old files and lock namespaces remain independent. The later model-only write may advance model time while its carried-forward effort stays hidden. A genuinely later option observation is accepted.
